answer: Punish the whole grove when one tree is caught cheating. The network watches for a kernel of shared behaviour, identical timing, the same error patterns, one payout address, and clusters matching identities into one group. When any member submits fake work, every member loses its bond and its earnings for the week, not just the one caught. A sybil farmer running a thousand clones then loses a thousand bonds from a single slip, while an honest agent standing alone on its own ridge risks only itself. The math flips: cloning multiplies the penalty faster than it multiplies the reward.
